# windows_power_plan (Data Source)

Reads the active power plan of the remote Windows host without managing it. This is a **singleton** data source — no lookup keys are required.

Exposes the active plan's resolved `plan_guid` and its localised `plan_name` (informational only), plus the full `plans` list (`guid`, `name`, `is_active`). Plan identity is GUID-only everywhere: names are localised and never used for matching.

The Terraform data source ID is the stable `machine_id` (HKLM MachineGuid).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    windows = {
      source  = "kfrlabs/windows"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "windows" {
  host     = var.windows_host
  username = var.windows_username
  password = var.windows_password
}

# Singleton — no lookup keys required.
data "windows_power_plan" "current" {}

output "plan_guid" {
  value = data.windows_power_plan.current.plan_guid
}

output "plan_name" {
  value = data.windows_power_plan.current.plan_name
}

output "plans" {
  value = data.windows_power_plan.current.plans
}

output "id" {
  value = data.windows_power_plan.current.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source ID; the stable machine ID (HKLM MachineGuid).
- `plan_guid` (String) Resolved GUID of the active power plan as observed on the host.
- `plan_name` (String) Localised display name (`ElementName`) of the active power plan. Informational only.
- `plans` (Attributes List) Every power plan known to the host, in host order (`guid`, `name`, `is_active`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `guid` (String) Plan GUID as observed on the host.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether this plan is the active plan.
- `name` (String) Localised display name (`ElementName`). Informational only.
